 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Viveka Nandsingh  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Chandra Bhushan Prasad- A.P.P.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 2 07-03-2025 1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in connection with Khagaria (Muffasil) P. S. Case No.408 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506, 323 and 348 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: Khagaria (Muffasil) P. S. Case No.408 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The learned APP Sri Chandra Bhushan Prasad submits that the offence for which the instant FIR has been instituted, carries punishment of less than seven years, the said submission of the learned APP is not disputed by learned Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.10009 of 2025(2) dt.07-03-2025 counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioner next submits that investigation in the case against the petitioner is still continuing, but then, the petitioner has not been given the benefit of Section 41(A)
of the Cr.P.C, on which the learned APP submits that the case be disposed of in terms of the order dated 13-2-2024 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 (Naushad Ansari vs. the State Aman Anand vs The State Of Bihar on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34130856/
1 of Bihar).
5.

In view of the submission made by the learned APP, the anticipatory bail application is disposed of in terms of the order dated 13-2-2024 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 (Naushad Ansari vs. the State of Bihar).
6.
